from collections import Counter
import json
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    nz=lambda row: sum(1 for x in row if x)
    line_rows=[r for r in range(H) if nz(g[r])>W/2]
    line_cols=[c for c in range(W) if nz([g[r][c] for r in range(H)])>H/2]
    def compress(n, positions):
        out=[]; prev=-1
        for p in positions:
            if p-prev>1: out.append('gap')
            out.append(p); prev=p
        if n-1-prev>0: out.append('gap')
        return out
    rows=compress(H,line_rows); cols=compress(W,line_cols)
    def color(line, idx, isrow):
        vals=[x for x in (line if isrow else [g[r][idx] for r in range(H)]) if x]
        return Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rowcol={r:color(g[r],None,True) for r in line_rows}
    colcol={c:color(None,c,False) for c in line_cols}
    out=[[0]*len(cols) for _ in rows]
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        for j,c in enumerate(cols):
            if r=='gap' and c=='gap': out[i][j]=0
            elif r=='gap': out[i][j]=colcol[c]
            elif c=='gap': out[i][j]=rowcol[r]
            else: out[i][j]=g[r][c]
    return out
